blocks.text: Stem cells khaas (unique) cells hain jin mein jism ke bohat se mukhtalif qisam ke cells ban jane ki hairat-angez salahiyat (ability) hai. Jab stem cell divide hota hai to har naya cell ya to stem cell hi reh sakta hai ya specialized (khaas kaam wala) cell ban sakta hai, jaise muscle cell, red blood cell ya dimagh (brain) ka cell. Jitni qisam ke cells yeh bana sakte hain, us ke hisab se stem cells ki bari qismein yeh hain:

items: Totipotent: yeh stem cells har mumkin qisam ka cell ban sakte hain. Misal: zygote (fertilized egg) aur zygote ki pehli chand divisions se bane cells.
Pluripotent: yeh taqreeban har qisam ka cell ban sakte hain. Misal: shuruati (early) embryo ke cells.

Multipotent: yeh aapas mein qareebi rishta rakhne wale cells ke ek khandan (family) mein badal sakte hain. Misal: hematopoietic (khoon banane wale) stem cells red blood cells, white blood cells ya platelets ban sakte hain.
Oligopotent: yeh sirf chand qisam ke cells ban sakte hain. Misal: adult lymphoid ya myeloid stem cells.
Unipotent: yeh sirf ek hi qisam ke cells, yani apni hi qisam, bana sakte hain. Phir bhi yeh stem cells hain kyun ke yeh khud ko dobara bana (renew kar) sakte hain. Misal: adult muscle stem cells.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Stem cell woh cell hai jo (1) divide ho kar apne jaisa stem cell bhi bana sakta hai aur (2) khaas kaam wale cells bhi. "Potent" ka matlab taqat hai: toti = sab, pluri = bohat, multi = kai (ek khandan), oligo = chand, uni = sirf ek.
